customManagers.description: Pinned release versions (VERSION=...) of the home-assistant init-container extensions (Lovelace cards + custom integrations).
KubeVirt and CDI operator GitHub-release URLs in kustomization.yaml.

Generic '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' annotations directly above a 'key: image:tag' or 'key: version' line — covers flat-string images in local charts (media stack), hardcoded images in chart templates, tag-only helm values (mosquitto), NAS container images in Ansible role defaults, and tool versions in GitHub workflow env blocks.

Pinned k3s, Helm and ArgoCD chart versions in the Ansible group_vars ('# renovate:' annotation directly above 'key: "version"'). Separate from the generic manager because k3s versions contain '+' and carry their own regex versioning.

packageRules.description: kubeseal-webgui v4.10+ has a broken kubernetes-client v36 in-cluster auth (api_key key mismatch). Disable auto-merge until upstream fixes it.
Postgres major version upgrades require a manual pg_upgrade of the data directory — never auto-merge them.
The k3s role installs Helm with the get-helm-3 script, which cannot install Helm 4. Moving to Helm 4 is a manual change of the role.

Lock file maintenance is only wanted for the npm lock of apps/gameserver-ui. Helm Chart.lock files change through their own chart-version PRs; maintenance would re-resolve every chart dependency at once.
No release-age wait for our own image: its digest moves on every merge to main (built and tested by the gameserver-ui workflow), so the age of the digest says nothing about trust.

Python for the lint workflows stays below the ceiling that the pinned ansible-core supports; a newer Python (the 3.x alias once resolved to 3.15) turned the required ansible-lint check red. Raise the ceiling deliberately.
renovate-config-validator runs on Node 24 (renovate needs ^24.11 || ^26.13, the validator crashed under Node 26 locally). Do not move the validator job to Node 26.
Renovate publishes several releases a day; bump the pinned validator version at most weekly.
AUTOMERGE: digest/minor/patch of GitHub Actions. CI-only, never reaches the cluster.
AUTOMERGE: npm devDependencies of gameserver-ui, non-major only (major bumps of typescript/eslint/vitest need a human).
AUTOMERGE: weekly lock file maintenance of gameserver-ui. Ends up in the next image build, so it is rolled out via the digest PR below.
AUTOMERGE = AUTOMATIC DEPLOYMENT: the digest of our own gameserver-ui image (argocd/apps/gameserver-ui/values.yaml). The image was built and tested from main by the gameserver-ui workflow.
AUTOMERGE = AUTOMATIC DEPLOYMENT: patch updates of container images and Helm charts under argocd/apps. Minor and major stay manual; the stateful/critical components are excluded by the rule below.

NEVER automerge these packages, whatever the update type (placed last so it wins over the rules above): cluster/GitOps core, operators with CRDs and storage, databases, home-assistant, monitoring stack, networking, certificates, DNS, kubeseal-webgui.
NEVER automerge anything in these app directories or in the Ansible group_vars (k3s, Helm and ArgoCD versions), even if the package name above does not match (images vendored in these charts).
